title.narrative: Responsible Business Conduct in Latin America and the Caribbean (RBCLAC)

description.narrative:
The project aims to foster smart, sustainable, and inclusive growth in the EU and Latin America and the Caribbean. This will be achieved by supporting responsible business conduct practices in line with internationally agreed principles set out in the UN, ILO, and OECD instruments, and taking into account EU regulatory and policy developments on RBC and due diligence.

Considering the experience of the RBC LAC project to date and the evolving priorities of the EU, activities for Phase II have been structured around three outcomes:

  1. Outcome 1. Improved practices by businesses and employers¿ organisations and supply chain actors on Responsible Business Conduct (RBC) due diligence, particularly in high impact sectors such as minerals/ extractives and agriculture, in line with internationally agreed instruments and standards
  2. Outcome 2. Improved and coherent policy, regulatory and legislative frameworks on RBC and their implementation in alignment with RBC instruments and standards
  3. Outcome 3. Improved role of the workers¿ organisations, civil society and communities in uptake of RBC
